title: A loan paid from an account in another currency is handled like a card (H5): left out of the walk with a warning until stage 2 (decision V2)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank (yen) holds 300,000, of which Free to spend 60,000 (typed). A peso loan owes 20,000.00, paid 2,000.00 on the 15th from the yen bank. Pay of 300,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Fri 15 Jan: the loan payment is ticked: 26,000 yen left the bank and 2,000.00 pesos arrived on the loan. Every amount is made up.

events.note: 26,000 yen left the bank, 2,000.00 pesos arrived on the loan

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 300,000 (bank today; the loan's 2,000.00 pesos on 15 Jan and 15 Feb are not taken off as yen, see the warning) = 300,000
asks.note: Before V2 the walk took 2,000.00 pesos off as 200,000 yen on each payment day: 100,000.

asks.question: warnings
asks.why: The peso loan is paid from the yen bank: the yen amount is not known until it is paid.

asks.question: owed_now
asks.why: 20,000.00 (owed at the opening; no payment day yet) = 20,000.00

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening; the bank's headroom is larger) = 60,000

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (opening) - 26,000 (the yen that left for the loan payment, Fri 15 Jan) = 274,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 274,000 (bank today; the 15 Feb payment is not taken off as yen) = 274,000
